evidence: Walked all 55 gate/scored criteria (2 gates, 43 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) against the frozen golden source; found none the reference cannot plausibly pass. (src/index.js:84-92); login shows Board/Conversations/Activity (public/js/app.js:87-122). constraints - UI open-job/add-candidate forms (board.js:40-83) persist in SQLite; observer bootstrap lists all jobs/apps (index.js:178-191). INTAKE: blank title, non-integer or out-of-range places, non-hiring-manager manager refused (index.js:204-207; UI sends NaN->null for 2.5, board.js:72); email regex + case-insensitive duplicate with details.field='candidate_email' (index.js:221-224); UI shows fault at the email field and keeps the name (board.js:52-55); appended at bottom (index.js:229); card meta shows source and email (board.js:251); job facts show manager, Interview heading shows places (board.js:327,366); team in job selector (board.js:353). MOVES: one-step rule, Hired cannot be rejected, blank reason refused, reopen only to rejected_from (index.js:248-255); arrival at bottom (index.js:306); up/down reorder via before_id (board.js:233-241); per-card version with stale 409 naming the last activity line, e.g. 'Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied' (index.js:241-245); Interview cap counted for the whole set and not applied to in-Interview reorder (index.js:290-295); bulk sorted to board order by stage then position (index.js:284-288) -> Y,W,X and A2,V; transaction .immediate() makes refusals atomic so refused actions log nothing (hro_activity_refusals). Roles: manager limited to own job and Interview/Offer/Hired incl. reject/reopen origin (index.js:257-264), role check precedes the Interview-cap check so the role refusal is what the judge sees; observer/candidate refused before card lookup (mayMove, index.js:326-333); undo/notes/jobs/candidates role-gated (index.js:202,216,348,391-394); anonymous gets 401 from auth() on every route incl. /api/bootstrap (board and activity read). UNDO: latest action only, single use, own only (index.js:350-351); refused if any of its cards' version changed, so another person's move, reorder or reject of that card blocks while a note or a different card does not (index.js:353-355); Interview overfill check (index.js:357-359); restores stage, place index, rejected_from and reason (index.js:363-365) -> V back at top of Applied, Y,W,X,Z,A2, C back in Rejected with its reason. PUT-BACK: optimistic localMove, snapshot restore on refusal, alert text, focus to the card's select (board.js:181-198). ACTIVITY: one actor-named line per card for every move/reject (with reason)/reopen/reorder/undo plus job-open and add lines (index.js:211,230,266-271,315-316,366); ORDER BY id DESC; per-job filter (app.js:45-85); observer receives activity. LIVE: every successful non-auth write broadcasts an SSE 'changed' event (index.js:48-53); client refreshes within 300 ms (app.js:133-157); board and thread list are patched in place with focus restored (board.js:321-341, threads.js:36-65); the detail note textarea is untouched by syncDetail. CONVERSATIONS: latest 30 oldest-first, before= paging 30 at a time with earlier_count (index.js:409-416), 'Show earlier messages (N more)' and scroll anchoring (threads.js:160-175); Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, blank refused, box cleared and refocused (threads.js:183-201); body white-space: pre-wrap (styles.css .message .body); scrolled-up arrival keeps place, shows '1 new message', no markRead until at bottom (threads.js:145-159,177-181); seen boundary = candidate's read for staff messages, recruiter or that job's manager for candidate messages, observer excluded (index.js:143-150); markRead suppressed while another view is active (threads.js:151-157); thread access: recruiter write, observer read, own manager write, other manager none (not listed / 403), candidate own else 404 (index.js:114-130). Drafts per user+conversation in localStorage keyed by user id (app.js:39-43; threads.js:112,124,182); session loss -> 401 -> sign-in prompt with email prefilled, nothing sent, draft restored after re-login through saved view and thread (app.js:34,189-195; threads.js:215-218); another user sees none (different key). Failed send: fetch rejection -> 'Not sent. The server could not be reached...' with text kept (app.js:31; threads.js:194). CANDIDATE: separate read model with job_title, team, status label only; no notes, reason, rejected_from, position, users or activity (index.js:171-176); card-detail/notes read of another application -> 404 (index.js:378-385); SSE payload is only 'data: 1'; candidate linked by account email on add (index.js:225-229); candidate conversation not auto-opened (threads.js:7). VISUAL: coherent token palette, type scale, spacing and consistent component styling (styles.css); plausibly scores high on the 5 likert rows. RUNTIME: raw-evidence-index hashes verified; scripted golden run (qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json) reports all 25 groups passed, incl. full-Interview put-back with focus, stale refusal naming who, bulk/undo through the page, live board arrival 804 ms with note/focus kept, 30-message paging keeping place, drafts across reload, ended-session resume, restart without reseed, no page errors. RESIDUAL RISK (why risk=true; not a defect): no full configured claude-code judge (Oracle) run exists for these bytes - the index scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent' and the driver 'does not walk every Functional criterion as the judge would' (e.g. no explicit Activity-line readback group or aborted-send group). Minor judge-interpretation exposures: the Activity view shows 50 lines then 'Show more (N earlier)' (app.js:66,79-83) so the judge must expand it for J1+J2; undo lines read 'X undid a move: Y is back in Applied' (names the stage returned to, not the origin); after a live message while a conversation is open, row/nav badges can show +1 for a few hundred ms before markRead's POST round-trips (threads.js:100-108,157), settled long before the 15 s read. None is a criterion the reference cannot pass. Tried a weak alternative (an app with client-only unread math or a broadcast that leaks data) and a conforming alternative (different routes/labels): criteria and prompts are route/label-agnostic, so they do not depend on golden-only choices for this row.
